item.title: McDonald's, Iran and the pope: Trump's bizarre press conference
item.summary: US President Donald Trump received a DoorDash delivery from McDonald's to the Oval Office during a press conference where he spoke about Iran and the pope.

item.title: Nigerian airstrike hits market in northeast Yobe state
item.summary: At least 200 people are feared dead after Nigerian military jets struck a village market while ​pursuing Islamist ‌militants in the northeast of the country on Saturday night, a councillor for ⁠the area and residents said on Sunday.

item.title: Italy suspends defence agreement with Israel as Lebanon attacks stoke tensions
item.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's government has suspended Italy's defence cooperation agreement with Israel amid rising tensions between the two countries after Rome accused Israeli forces of firing warning shots at a convoy of Italian UN peacekeepers in Lebanon.

item.title: Pope says doesn't fear Trump as he pushes back in Iran war feud
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV pushed back Monday on President Donald Trump’s broadside against him over the US-Israel war in Iran, telling reporters that the Vatican’s appeals for peace and reconciliation are rooted in the Gospel, and that he doesn’t fear the Trump administration.

item.title: Hollywood stars speak out against Paramount-Warner deal
item.summary: An open letter signed by hundreds of Hollywood heavyweights, including Jane Fonda, Joaquin Phoenix and Bryan Cranston, was published Monday opposing a deal that would see the historic Warner Bros. studio swallowed by rival Paramount.
